# Maintainers

This document lists the maintainers of the `vastdata.vms` Ansible collection.

## Current Maintainers

| Name      | Affiliation | Area                |
| --------- | ----------- | ------------------- |
| VAST Data | VAST Data   | All modules / roles |

Maintainers are responsible for reviewing and merging contributions, triaging
issues, cutting releases, and upholding the project [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## Becoming a Maintainer

Contributors with a sustained track record of high-quality contributions and
reviews may be nominated as maintainers by an existing maintainer. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for how to get involved.

## Contact

- Security: [security@vastdata.com](mailto:security@vastdata.com)
